Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our call:

- Commercial path options we discussed: PO (preferred for finance) vs. corporate card for initial trial.
- Action items for Orion: vendor portal invitation, vendor intake packet, W-9/W-8 if applicable, banking details for EFT.
- Action items for Redwood: provide completed procurement intake form, signed W-9, sample invoice, and vendor details.

I've attached our procurement intake form and a signed W-9 to accelerate vendor setup. Marissa (cc'd) will own the vendor packet and handle any questions on banking details.

Proposed timeline:
1) Today: Redwood sends intake form + W-9 (attached).
2) Tomorrow: Orion sends vendor portal invite & confirms PO vs card path.
3) End of week: PO issued or card tested for first invoice.

Please confirm who on your side will own the vendor portal setup and whether your procurement team needs any additional documents (insurance cert, bank letter).

Thanks,
Dylan
